role: Acting Assistant Administrative Director, Governor's Office of Human Resources
stance_basis: letter explicitly states no adverse environmental effects found relative to office's areas of expertise
summary: Carolyn A. Kruse, Acting Assistant Administrative Director of the Governor's Office of Human Resources, submitted a letter on May 9, 1972 finding no adverse environmental effects from the listed projects, including FA Route 23 (U.S. Route 30), Section 22-23-12-R, Cook County. She determined the projects would cause no major displacement of urban housing and no significant impact on lower income neighborhoods. No agency response was provided, as her letter itself constituted a clearance finding.
complaint_summary: Kruse's letter finds that the listed projects, including FA Route 23 (U.S. Route 30) Section 22-23-12-R, will cause no major displacement of urban housing nor significant impact on lower income neighborhoods, and therefore no adverse environmental effects relative to the office's areas of expertise.

statement.text:
As required by the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, the Governor's Office of Human Resources has reviewed the attached listing of projects and has found that those projects will precipitate no major displacement of urban housing nor have any significant impact upon lower income neighborhoods; consequently, this office finds no adverse environmental effects relative to its particular areas of expertise and interest.
